description: This file defines scheduling-related API types for Kubernetes, including PriorityClass, Workload, PodGroup, and associated policies, with constants for priority ranges and system-critical classes.

classes.name: PriorityClass
classes.description: Defines a priority class with a name, value, default flag, description, and preemption policy.

classes.name: Workload
classes.description: Represents a workload with scheduling constraints, including metadata and spec.

classes.name: WorkloadSpec
classes.description: Specifies the desired state of a Workload, including controller reference and pod groups.

classes.name: TypedLocalObjectReference
classes.description: References a typed object within the same namespace.

classes.name: PodGroup
classes.description: Represents a set of pods with a common scheduling policy.

classes.name: PodGroupPolicy
classes.description: Defines scheduling policies for a PodGroup, including basic and gang policies.

classes.name: GangSchedulingPolicy
classes.description: Defines parameters for gang scheduling, including minimum count.
